items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, anyway, you may think of it. I was going to, there's a couple of questions here. Dick asked me to find out.

ctx.x: Money, now you think a lot of people have money Mr. Bill. I don't say like people, you know like people invest money, you know what I mean? Like in different kind of concern. You see? Well look, you got income. Look, you got income coming from this place. You got income coming from that place. Well, some of them business drops too, you know. You know what I mean? Markets drops, you know, like anything else. You know what I mean? But you still got money coming in. You see? But now you take a first, you know, you…
Well, anyway, you may think of it. I was going to, there's a couple of questions here. Dick asked me to find out.
